svg.aria-label: Legend: every plant is a day of GitHub activity. 0 contributions is bare soil, 1 a sprout, 2 to 3 a seedling, 4 to 6 growing, 7 or more ready to harvest.

svg.text: Every plant is a day of my GitHub activity. Busier days grow bigger crops. Redrawn daily.
